answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The desk only stamps a name that carries Decreed scribe gold charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter scribes sign after parchment checks. Each name is charged 160 separate visits, each one billed $7 at the door, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. lagoon stays on the record. vault is written on the receipt. The sonnet is on the docket.
